summary: Iteration 6 voice-Moment logging: full backend coverage with 11/11 new pytest tests PASS (real Whisper + Claude calls via Emergent LLM key, error paths, persistence, CSV transcript column, regression). 60/60 prior backend regression (moments/missionboard/streak/games-clues) still PASS. Frontend: parent Moments + student check-in voice UIs render correctly — Speak it opens moments-voice-panel with the AudioRecorder (audio-recorder + audio-record-start visible), voice-skip falls back to moments-form, and existing voice-note moments render moment-transcript-<id> banner + moment-audio-<id> audio element. Student check-in mode picker shows both checkin-mode-voice (recorder loads) and checkin-mode-tap (step 1 still works) — no regression on prior iteration 5 tap flow. All key testids match the spec.

minor.issue: When Whisper raises (e.g. malformed audio bytes), endpoint returns 502 with raw exception string in detail — leaks internal error text. Consider masking with a friendly message and logging the original via logger.exception (already done).

Whisper transcribed a pure 200Hz sine wave to 'You' — Claude then returned moment_type='frustrated' as fallback, which is correct per spec but means the 422 'empty transcript' branch is effectively unreachable for any non-empty audio. Documented behaviour, not a bug, but the spec's '422 if Whisper returns empty' is therefore largely theoretical.

Carried over from iteration 5: MomentCreate.student_id is now Optional[str]=None (verified — student check-in test_student_self_log passes without supplying the field). Previously flagged critical, now resolved.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise the actual MediaRecorder→upload→Claude→prefill flow end-to-end in headless Chromium because there is no real microphone source. The path was verified piecewise: (a) AudioRecorder mounts with audio-record-start visible, (b) backend /moments/parse-audio returns the correct shape with a real WAV upload from pytest, (c) the form correctly renders transcript + audio playback on existing moments. Main agent should manually verify the full record→preview→auto-upload→onParsed→prefill→submit chain in a real browser with a working mic.

action_items: Manually smoke-test the full voice flow once in a real browser (parent: /parent/moments → Speak it → record 3-5 sec → confirm modal switches to moments-form with prefilled type/intensity/triggers + moments-form-transcript banner → Save → moment appears in list with moment-transcript-<id> + moment-audio-<id>). The pieces are individually verified but the end-to-end record→upload was not exerciseable from headless Chromium.
(Optional) Mask the raw transcription exception in the 502 detail to avoid leaking internal error strings to the client.
(Carried) server.py is now ~1473 lines — overdue to split into routers/ (auth, missions, logs, streak, AI, games, moments, voice).
critical_code_review_comments: moments_parse_audio correctly clamps intensity to 1-5 and filters triggers to valid catalog keys with fuzzy fallback by label — verified by test_parsed_moment_type_is_valid_catalog_key.
moment_type fallback chain (exact key → fuzzy label → 'frustrated') is correct and was exercised in the smoke test (sine wave → 'frustrated').
Audio MIME-to-extension mapping is reasonable (webm/wav/m4a/mp3/ogg). buf.name is set before passing to Whisper — necessary because OpenAI's SDK detects format from filename.
POST /api/moments enforces 7M-char (~5MB) cap on audio_data and returns 413 — verified by test_post_moment_audio_too_large_413.

GET /api/moments includes audio_data/audio_mime/transcript on every Moment, with None defaults for older moments — verified by test_get_moments_returns_audio_fields and test_create_moment_without_audio_fields_ok.
CSV export's 'transcript' column is correctly last in the header and properly quoted — verified by test_csv_header_has_transcript_last.
Auth: parse-audio uses only get_current_user (no role gate) — both parent and student succeed. Verified by test_student_parse_audio_ok + test_parent_parse_audio_ok.

AudioRecorder.jsx has all expected testids (recorder, start/stop, elapsed, preview, element, play, discard, uploading, error). State machine: not-supported → idle (record-start) → recording (record-stop + elapsed) → preview (audio + play/discard/upload) → uploading → onParsed callback fires. Verified visually for idle + record-start state.

MomentsTracker.jsx and StudentCheckIn.jsx correctly use Optional auto-load of the linked student (selected) before the Speak it button enables — initial test failed because I clicked too early; second run with a 2s wait succeeded.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_moments_audio.py (NEW, 11 tests in 5 classes — parse-audio happy/error, persistence, CSV transcript, no-audio regression)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on what can be statically verified (modal opens, recorder renders, testids match, transcript/audio render on existing moments, student mode picker + voice panel + tap-path regression). Real record→upload chain not exerciseable from headless.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_moments_audio.py -v` (expect 11/11 in ~13s; hits live Whisper). Full backend non-AI: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --ignore=/app/backend/tests/test_ai_drafting.py` (expect 71/71). Voice UI testids used: AudioRecorder = audio-recorder, audio-not-supported, audio-record-start, audio-record-stop, audio-elapsed, audio-preview, audio-element, audio-play, audio-discard, audio-upload, audio-uploading, audio-error. MomentsTracker = moments-speak, moments-voice-panel, moments-voice-close, moments-voice-skip, moments-form-transcript, moment-transcript-<id>, moment-audio-<id>. StudentCheckIn = checkin-mode, checkin-mode-voice, checkin-mode-tap, checkin-voice-panel, checkin-voice-back, checkin-transcript. Note: in MomentsTracker the Speak it button is disabled until `selected` student loads — always wait ~1.5-2s after the page mounts before clicking.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified that block functionality. The single integration item to call out is that headless Chromium cannot supply a real microphone audio stream, so the full record→upload→Claude→prefill chain can only be smoke-tested manually in a real browser. The backend half of that chain is fully covered by test_moments_audio.py (11 tests, all PASS) and the frontend half (modal mount + transcript/audio rendering on existing moments) is covered by the Playwright run above.
